changelog.change: OBS Chapter Marker support via websocket and fixed Twitch connection encoding bug.
Added a stream session log: while OBS is streaming, marks are appended to a per-date file.
Falls back to a separate per-date log file when OBS can't create a chapter marker (only Hybrid MP4 and Hybrid MOV recordings support them).
Connects to OBS only when needed for each action, instead of holding a persistent connection open.
Every marker is now tagged with the event that triggered it, e.g. [STARTED], [SPLIT], [FINISHED], [RESET].
Added a tunable timestamp offset setting to correct for a fixed encoder/muxer buffering delay in logged timestamps.
All notifications can now be toggled with a single switch.
Fixed settings controls not refreshing after saved values were loaded.
Fixed update bug (please, download it again from the github), now it receives Twitch API tokens without running it as Administrator.
Fixed bugs and using correct Twitch API endpoints.
